partition_boundary.analog: Planned devices under test and analog measurement paths from the selected device to the force and sense pads. The selection switches receive control from the digital partition. Issue #1 defines the device map and pad connections.
partition_boundary.digital: The digital controller decodes the address and drives bank, member and oscillator enables. It divides eight buffered logic-domain ring inputs to drive RO_OUT. The analog partition supplies those buffered crossings and the switch and pad connections.
